template.reference: thirdjam's match on the rink core, as engine/cores/rink and engine/packs/hokej
copies: thirdjam's match on the rink core, unchanged: its skating, puck, contact and bots; the core carries the feel.
thirdjam's camera and keys, unchanged: view bound to your skater; mouse buttons act with or without puck.
Cartridge keys changed: rink size, teams, rules, zones for fast and slow patches, look, corner bumpers.
Rules sidecar only where no cartridge key exists: bumper kick and the double-goal window.
Skin: title, team names, colours and words, started from engine/templates/rink_game.

candidates.pitch: I own the pond: race across fast ice, dodge slow patches, ricochet pucks off springy corner bumpers.
I'm the pond trickster: fire into corner bumpers, pounce on the kick, and score goals worth double.
I'm the thaw reader: after every goal the fast and slow patches move, and I adapt first.
I'm the comeback schemer: whenever we concede, I drop a fresh slow patch to trap their rush.
I'm the bumper king: each corner hit charges the puck faster until someone scores that screaming rocket.

concept.why: Pond trickster: within 30 seconds you fire into a corner, the bumper kicks it slotward, and your finish counts two. The faithful reading gives bumpers less reason to be aimed at.
concept.hook: goals struck off the corner bumpers count double

references.borrow: Pass across the crease and shoot as it arrives; the goalie cannot get across in time.
Drive over a dash panel for instant speed; off-road slows you, so the racing line becomes a choice.
Ball touches a pop bumper; it kicks the ball away faster, with an instant flash and bang.
